name: Guthallath Rockslide

stealth.note: (master) to notice the odd aging of the stones, seemingly far older and more weathered than the surrounding rocks

description: The rock walls nearby begin to crumble and collapse.
disable: DC 48 Crafting check (legendary) to buttress the collapsing rocks in three different locations. Using large and durable materials (or applicable spells) to support the rocks reduces the check to DC 45 Crafting check (master).
reset: The guthallath can reset the hazard with a few days of work stacking the fallen rocks.
routine:
(2 actions) On the hazard's first action, any areas of crumbling rocks from a previous round collapse, making a falling rocks Strike against each creature in the area.

On its second action, the hazard crumbles rocks in a 20-foot radius around the previous collapse. A character can Seek (DC 40) to determine where the rocks will fall on the following round, but on a critical failure, they incorrectly identify where the rocks will fall.

hp.note: Hardness 20 BT 75. Hardness 10 in the guthallath's erosion aura

offensiveAbilities.name: Rumbling Rocks
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The guthallath rolls initiative

Effect The rocks of the area begin to crumble. The hazard rolls for initiative.

offensiveAbilities.name: Early Collapse
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The hazard takes 30 or more damage

Effect Move the hazard's initiative to immediately follow the creature that damaged the hazard.
